bullets: How Accurate is the Classification (for Both Positive and Negative Classes)
What About Precision of Positive Class ONLY Results?
What About Recall % of Positive Samples ?
Conclusion: Accuracy is Good but Not Sufficient

layout.arrangement: Title 'Accuracy' at top center-left. Below it a grey definition strip spanning most of the width. Left column contains 'Meaning' section, formula box, calculation box, and yellow question box stacked vertically. Right column contains two confusion matrices stacked at top-right, and two tree diagrams side-by-side at bottom-right. Slide number '6' in a yellow circle at extreme top-right corner.

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates via size and red color. Definition strip is secondary. Formula box and numeric calculation are emphasized with borders. Tree diagrams and matrices use color coding (red/green circles). Yellow box at bottom draws attention to conclusion.

visual_elements.description: Confusion matrix (symbolic). Header 'Predicted as'. Columns P, N. Rows Actual P, Actual N. Cells: TP (green fill), FN, FP, TN (green fill).
Confusion matrix (numeric). Header 'Predicted as'. Columns P, N. Rows Actual P, Actual N. Cells: 18 (green fill), 12, 10, 60 (green fill).
Tree diagram labeled 'Positive' in red. Root node red circle '30'. Left branch to red circle '18' labeled 'TP'. Right branch to green circle '12' labeled 'FN'.
Tree diagram labeled 'Negative' in green. Root node green circle '70'. Left branch to green circle '60' labeled 'TN'. Right branch to red circle '10' labeled 'FP'.
Red-bordered box containing the accuracy formula and 'All Samples' text below it.
Light blue box containing the numeric accuracy calculation.
Yellow box containing three lines of text about precision, recall, and conclusion.

imagery.description: Two small airplane icons above the tree diagrams: one above 'Positive' (grey outline with star), one above 'Negative' (grey outline with windows).
imagery.position: Above each tree diagram in bottom-right region

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout (likely Calibri or Arial). Title is large, bold, red, all-caps style. Body text is black regular weight. Some emphasis text is red and italicized (e.g., 'Meaning', 'All Samples', 'Accuracy of ALL Classes', conclusion line). 'Positive' and 'Negative' in the Meaning line are blue. Slide number is black inside a yellow circle.
animation_state: Static slide; no mid-build or partial reveal apparent.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light grey (#F2F2F2). 2. Add title 'Accuracy' at top center-left in large bold red (#C00000) sans-serif. 3. Add a grey rectangular strip below title spanning most width; inside place 'Correctly Classified (Positive & Negative)' with a red underline beneath it, then 'Total Number of Samples' below the line. 4. On the left side, add red bold 'Meaning', then the line 'How Accurate is the Classification (for Both Positive and Negative Classes)' with 'Positive' and 'Negative' in blue. 5. Add a red-bordered box with 'Correctly Classified' in red italic above it, then the formula 'Accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + FP + TN + FN)', then 'All Samples' in red italic below the formula. 6. Add a light blue box with 'Accuracy= (18+60)/(18+12+60+10) = 78/100 = 78%'; to its right add 'Accuracy of ALL Classes' in red italic. 7. Add a yellow box at bottom-left with three lines: 'What About Precision of Positive Class ONLY Results?', 'What About Recall % of Positive Samples ?', 'Conclusion: Accuracy is Good but Not Sufficient' (last line in red). 8. Top-right: add slide number '6' in a yellow circle. 9. Below the number, add two confusion matrices stacked vertically: first symbolic with headers Predicted as / P / N / Actual and cells TP, FN, FP, TN (TP and TN green-filled); second numeric with same headers and cells 18, 12, 10, 60 (18 and 60 green-filled). 10. Bottom-right: add two tree diagrams side by side. Left labeled 'Positive' in red: root red circle '30', children red circle '18' (label TP) and green circle '12' (label FN). Right labeled 'Negative' in green: root green circle '70', children green circle '60' (label TN) and red circle '10' (label FP). 11. Place small grey airplane line icons above each tree diagram.
